props.name: autofocus
props.description: Whether to automatically focus the textarea on mount.

props.name: autofocusDelay
props.description: Delay in milliseconds before focusing the textarea.

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Whether the textarea should automatically resize based on content.

props.name: autoResizeDelay
props.description: Delay in milliseconds before triggering autoresize on mount.

props.name: children
props.description: Native controls do not accept child content.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value of the input (uncontrolled).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the input is disabled.

props.name: id
props.description: The ID of the input element.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Maximum character length for the textarea.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Maximum number of rows allowed during autoresize.

props.name: modelModifiers
props.description: Modifiers for input processing (e.g., lazy, trim, number).

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input element, used for form submission.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Native blur event handler.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Native change event, after value synchronization and Field notification.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Native focus event handler.

props.name: onInput
props.description: Native input event handler.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback when the textarea value changes during input.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text for the textarea.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the input is read-only.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref for the native textarea element.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the input is required.

props.name: rows
props.description: Default number of rows.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value of the input (controlled).

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual treatment of the component.
